claim: Club 55 (club55.fr, iconic chic/classic since 1955), Moorea Plage (party/family, €8 parking), Bagatelle, La Serena (family) and Tahiti Beach are leading Pampelonne clubs with 2026 sunbeds roughly €45-60.
quote: Club 55 | Chic/Classic | €60 | club55.fr ... Moorea Plage | Party/Family | €50-70 | mooreaplage.fr | Established 1952; €8 parking ... Bagatelle | Luxury Party | €60 ... La Serena | Relaxed/Food | €50 ... Tahiti Beach | Family-Friendly | €50

claim: Pampelonne clubs split by vibe: party (Nikki Beach champagne-shower pool parties, Verde Beach, Moorea, Bagatelle, Club 55 celebrity), chic (La Réserve à la Plage, Byblos Beach, Shellona, Club Les Palmiers), and family-friendly (La Serena).
quote: Nikki Beach | Party - Pool-centric with DJ sets, dance performances, champagne showers ... La Reserve a la Plage | Chic - Elegant unwinding ... La Serena | Family - Family-friendly fun ... Club 55 | Party/Celebrity - Legendary since 1955, famous for celebrity-spotting

claim: Pampelonne beach has over 20 different beach clubs including Nikki Beach, Club 55, Bagatelle, Verde Beach, Moorea, La Serena, Tropezina, Tahiti, Bora Bora and Le Lagon.
quote: Pampelonne has over 20 different beach clubs ... Nikki Beach, Club 55, and Bagatelle ... Verde Beach (best food), Moorea (party atmosphere), La Serena (most relaxing) ... Tahiti, Bora Bora Beach, Le Lagon

claim: Plage des Salins is a 500m wild white-sand family beach about 7km north of Saint-Tropez town, with free parking via Moutte park (5-minute walk) and lifeguard cover June-September.
quote: north of the infamous stretch known as Pampelonne beach and about 7km from the town ... white sand beach stretches out over 500 meters ... by the Moutte park with free parking and a five minute shady walk ... family beach and guarded ... not easy to park in the summer but it's free

claim: Plage de la Bouillabaisse sits at the town entrance between Saint-Tropez and Gassin with free public access plus private sections, parking and beach restaurants (Pearl Beach, 270°, La Bouillabaisse), and is rated the best sunset spot.
quote: along the coastline between Saint-Tropez and Gassin ... both private sections and public coastline available to visitors at no cost ... Pearl Beach, 270° by Golfe Azur, and La Bouillabaisse beach club ... best spot to admire the sun going down behind the hills of the Massif des Maures

claim: Pampelonne has six public access points and parking lots (rte de Tahiti, chemin des Moulins, chemin de Tamaris, bd Patch, chemin des Barraques, rte de Bonne Terrasse) with parking from about €5.50; the beach is a 10-minute (~2.8 mile) drive from town with a summer Bus des Plages shuttle.
quote: Public entries and parking for €5.50 are available at one of six access points: rte de Tahiti, chemin des Moulins, chemin de Tamaris, bd Patch, chemin des Barraques and rte de Bonne Terrasse ... around 10 minutes to reach by car from the town centre

claim: Most Pampelonne private clubs rent sunbeds from around €30-40 up to €150 per day depending on club and season, with Club 55 the original and most famous restaurant-club.
quote: most beaches on Pampelonne offer sunbeds from around €30-40, while sunbeds at some venues are priced from €40 up to €150

claim: Pampelonne public paid parking runs roughly €5-10 for a few hours or €15-20 for a full day in peak 2026, with limited free roadside parking and risk of towing for illegal parking.
quote: expect to pay anywhere from 5-10 euros for a few hours, or 15-20 euros for a full day during peak season in 2026 ... Limited free parking is available near Pampelonne Beach, primarily along informal roadside spots ... Illegally parked cars are subject to towing

claim: Plage de la Ponche is Saint-Tropez's most central beach, a tiny 50m free sand-and-pebble cove in the old town reachable only on foot from the port or citadel, with no amenities or beach bars.
quote: the most central beach in Saint-Tropez ... extends for only 50 meters ... only accessible on foot from the port or the citadel ... You won't find any amenities or beach bars here ... free to access
